newsitem.title: USA: Parlex names Peter Murphy CEO.
newsitem.headline: Parlex names Peter Murphy CEO.

text.p: Parlex Corp said Tuesday that it named Peter J. Murphy, its president since 1995, chief executive officer, effective July 1.
Murphy joined Parlex in 1992 and has been a director since 1994, the company said.
The company said its founder, Herbert Pollack, who is chairman and current chief executive, will continue as chairman and remain active with the company in that capacity.
Parlex makes custom flexible circuits and laminated cables used in the automotive, computer, telecommunications, industrial controls, medical, consumer and military-aerospace industries.
